trends.name: Iran Conflict Oil Supply Disruption
trends.summary: Iran successfully targeted oil/gas production facilities for the first time, hitting fields in UAE (Shah) and Iraq (Majnoon), plus Saudi Arabia drone swarms. Oil jumped 2%+ on shipping route protection doubts. U.S. gas prices up 25% since war began. Direct threat to global energy supply and inflation outlook.

trends.name: Nvidia AI Dominance & $1T Revenue Projection
trends.summary: Nvidia announced chip partnership tie-ups, doubled revenue forecast for key chips, and CEO Jensen Huang projects $1 trillion in Blackwell/Vera Rubin orders through 2027. Demonstrates sustained AI infrastructure demand and company's monopolistic positioning in GPU market.

trends.name: Global Stagflation Risk & Central Bank Divergence
trends.summary: Australia raised rates to near 1-year high amid Iran inflation risks, while Canada's inflation fell to 1.8%. Fed officials face diverging mandates between inflation control and growth. Moody's warns recession likely if oil stays elevated. Stagflation from government policies seen as greater risk than oil alone.

trends.name: U.S. Jobs Market Deterioration Signal
trends.summary: Perceived probability for households to find new role within 3 months after job loss dropped to 44.0% (2nd-lowest on record), down 12 points since October 2024. Critical indicator of labor market tightening and rising employment anxiety affecting consumer confidence.

trends.name: AI Bubble Reset & Valuation Compression
trends.summary: Bill Gurley warns AI bubble reset is coming after 'a bunch of people got rich quick.' Nasdaq 100 P/E compressed from 29x to 24x, signaling investor repricing of tech valuations. Market remains resilient on oil pullback, but sector correction appears underway.

trends.name: SEC Earnings Reporting Overhaul
trends.summary: SEC preparing proposal to eliminate quarterly earnings requirements and allow semi-annual reporting instead, expected publication next month. Major shift in corporate transparency and earnings cycle that could impact market volatility and analyst forecasting.

trends.name: Trump Geopolitical Interventions & China Tensions
trends.summary: Trump says U.S. requested China delay Xi summit by 'a month or so' due to Iran war, and claims he'll have 'honor' of 'taking Cuba.' Signals escalating geopolitical risk and potential trade/diplomatic disruptions affecting markets and emerging market sentiment.

trends.name: Tech M&A Activity & Apple Strategic Moves
trends.summary: Apple acquired video editing company MotionVFX to boost streaming subscribers. Ant Group regulatory approval sent shares up 70% on Bright Smart takeover. Reflects tech giants consolidating adjacent assets to defend subscriber bases and ecosystem lock-in.

trends.name: Global Supply Chain & Fertilizer Export Halt
trends.summary: Chinese government asked exporters to halt outbound shipments of nitrogen-potassium fertilizer blends. Signals agricultural commodity supply tightening and potential food price inflation risks globally, following deflationary trends in New Zealand and Canada.

trends.name: Cyber Espionage & North Korean Tech Infiltration
trends.summary: North Korean operatives infiltrating U.S. companies through remote tech jobs, posing security and IP theft risks. Critical risk factor for corporate cybersecurity and potential supply chain vulnerabilities in tech/defense sectors.

trends.name: GLP-1 Pill Innovation & Healthcare Competition
trends.summary: New biotech developing GLP-1 pill potentially superior to Wegovy injectable formulation. Represents competitive threat to established obesity/diabetes drug makers and signals shift toward more convenient oral delivery in high-growth sector.

trends.name: AI Workplace Integration & Labor Friction
trends.summary: Employers report AI makes workers faster but creates 'friction or mistrust,' per report. Highlights emerging organizational challenges of AI adoption, potentially suppressing productivity gains and creating labor management risks.
